title.en: An Act Making Appropriations for Current Expenses and Public Works and Permanent Improvements in the Department of Mindanao and Sulu for the Fiscal Year Ending December thirty-First, Nineteen Hundred Fifteen.

text.en:
The following sums or so much thereof as may be necessary are hereby appropriated out of any
funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated as Insular aid to the Department of Mindanao and
Sulu for the fiscal year ending December thirty-first, nineteen hundred fifteen, subject to detailed
appropriation by the administrative council under the supervision of the Philippine Commission as provided
by section six (a) of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and eight:
For the expense of the department government, including the offices of the governor and members of the
administrative council, and otherwise as the public service may require : Provided, That the Governor-General
may require the department secretary or an assistant to the department governor to perform the duties of
department treasurer or department attorney as in his discretion may be to the greatest advantage to the public
?212,000.00
For aid in the current expenses of the provincial government of Agusan and the newly organized Provinces of
Bukidnon, Cotabato, Davao, Lanao, Sulu, and Zamboanga
365,000.00
For superintendence, maintenance, and other expense of primary schools including educational work among
adults in elementary civics, agriculture, and household industries 225,000.00 For superintendence,
maintenance, and other expense of dispensary stations, public hospitals, and health service
130,000.00
For aid in the provision by artesian wells or otherwise of potable water for municipalities ; for the construction
and improvement of bridges, roads, and trails; provision of landing facilities in the form of piers, wharves, and
otherwise at minor ports; removal of obstructions to navigation; and the extension of telephone lines; for the
maintenance of wharves and mooring buoys at the ports of Jolo and Zamboanga and the reconstruction of the
wharf at Zamboanga, including the repayment to Insular trust funds of the sum of thirty-two thousand pesos
and interest thereon, which was loaned to the Moro Province and expended for the improvement of that port
300,000.00
For the payment to Insular trust funds of the loan of fifteen thousand pesos with interest thereon, and refund to
the municipal government of Dapitan of payments made on these accounts, for the Insular project of the Rizal
Memorial at Dapitan
16,000.00
For the installation and operation of small radio stations, telegraph lines, marine cables, and other . extensions
of the Insular telegraph service to be expended by the Director of Posts under the supervision of the Secretary
of Commerce and Police

25,000.00
____________
Total of appropriations by this Act..
1,273,000.00

Authority is hereby granted Lieutenant A. K. Buck, Philippine Constabulary, acting as assistant
to the governor of the Province of Agusan for the district of Gibung-Simulao, for the period January first to
August thirty-first, to receive compensation in addition to his pay and allowances as an officer of the
Philippine Constabulary notwithstanding the provisions of Act Numbered One hundred and forty-eight,
Philippine Commission.
The provisions of the last paragraph of section seven of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and eight are
hereby made applicable to the Provinces of Agusan and Bukidnon as of date January first, nineteen hundred

The unexpended and unappropriated balances of unexpended and funds pertaining to the
treasury of the Department of Mindanao and Sulu on December thirty-first, nineteen hundred fourteen, shall
be available for reappropriation by the administrative council subject to the supervision of the Philippine
Commission as provided by section six (a) of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and eight.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 3, 1914.
